blockers.detail: No composable multi-session masking construction covers GKR, dedicated MatMul, native Lasso, lookup/input consistency, input combine, and W/Aux/L terminal openings while reusing com_W.
The retained Python graft uses digests, sampled table evaluations, and direct accumulators; it is not the complete native Lasso commitment/Sumcheck/opening argument required by the protocol.
The retained relation checks are host-generated residual and product-sum objects, not a verifier-replayed ML-friendly layered GKR proof bound to the four-segment input layer.
The retained seven-segment graft does not implement X|W|Aux|L with 00/01/10/11 selectors, lookup/input consistency, and native com_W/com_aux/com_L terminal openings at the combined point.

The active Python path replaces BN254 group commitments with field-linear values and deterministic blinders; the mcl Hyrax reference CLI is not connected to the runner and its blinders are also deterministic.
The retained forward path uses floating-point normalization/activations and approximate rescale residuals instead of the protocol's exact integer tables and SignedRoundDiv relation.
The CUDA component is a u64 digest/reduction kernel over CPU-generated proof words, not GPU execution of Hyrax, Lasso, MatMul Sumcheck, or GKR proving primitives.
The declared 3rd/mcl submodule is unpopulated, so the retained native BN254 reference CLI cannot be built in the current checkout.
